ControlPanel/Intro: Configure how the recipe edition behaves.
ControlPanel/Filename/Description: The default name for the file when you save a copy of this wiki via //Save changes//.
ControlPanel/Photos/Description: Photos add visual richness, but sourcing and attributing public images takes effort.  Pick the option that matches how you plan to work — edit forms and the Recipe Box dashboard adapt accordingly.  Recipes and ingredients always display any photos that are attached, regardless of mode.
ControlPanel/Photos/Own: Use my own photos (no attribution required)
ControlPanel/ExtraFields/Description: These fields appear in the metadata strip at the top of each recipe view, and are routed to a placeholder-aware editor in the field list when you author a recipe.  Edit a row to change its caption, placeholder hint, or display template; remove a row to drop the field from the strip and the editor cascade.
